lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately six horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters (spots) extending from the posterior margin of the fifth gill slit across the mid-lateral flank. The highest-intensity maxima are clustered in the dorsal-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, forming a semi-regular grid of anchor nodes most discernible in the region immediately posterior to the gill slits.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance transition from light pixels above to a shadowed gradient below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, circular depigmented area containing internal dark pigmentation is visible posterior to the pectoral fin insertion area. Multiple small, high-contrast dark punctate marks are located on the lower posterior flank.
